reconcile.note: Clarke distinguishes the stupefying drink Jesus refused before death from the plain sour wine he received from thirst just before dying.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible poses a flat clash, since the Synoptic Jesus refuses the drink offered him while the Johannine Jesus receives and drinks it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.
sides.verseText: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.

sides.snippet: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar
sides.verseText: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, \"It is finished.\" He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.
